hunks.after:
union all
    select g.id,g.display_name,g.source_family,rs.client_id,cl.name,rc.id,rc.scope_client_id,
      rc.finalisation_week_ending,rc.cutoff_at_utc,rc.version,rc.current_complete_upload_id,rc.current_projection_publication_id,
      rs.id,rs.version,rs.current_complete_upload_id,rs.current_projection_publication_id,
      fr.id,case when fr.id is not null then 'FINAL_SOURCE' end,fr.finalised_at_utc,encode(fr.manifest_hash,'hex'),rs.cutoff_at_utc
    from public.weekly_source_report_scopes rs join public.weekly_source_self_bill_reports sr on sr.id=rs.self_bill_report_id
    join public.weekly_source_cycles rc on rc.id=rs.source_cycle_id
    join public.weekly_source_groups g on g.id=rs.source_group_id and g.active and g.source_family='ROSTER'
    join public.clients cl on cl.id=rs.client_id
    left join public.weekly_source_final_revisions fr on fr.id=rs.current_final_revision_id
      and fr.report_scope_id=rs.id and fr.authority_scope_kind='SELF_BILL_REPORT_SCOPE' and fr.state='CURRENT'
    -- Invoice-only report scopes are hidden from the reduced pay workspace.
    where exists(select 1 from public.tms_users actor where actor.id=v_actor and actor.is_active
      and lower(btrim(coalesce(actor.role,'')))='admin')
      and (v_group is null or rs.source_group_id=v_group) and (v_client is null or rs.client_id=v_client)
      and (v_week is null or rc.finalisation_week_ending=v_week)
      and exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_group_clients gc where gc.source_group_id=rs.source_group_id
        and gc.client_id=rs.client_id and rc.finalisation_week_ending between gc.valid_from and coalesce(gc.valid_to,'infinity'::date))
